faqs.q: How much does a doula cost in Orange, CA?
faqs.a: Most birth doula packages in Orange run between $1,800 and $3,000. Sacred Journey Childbirth charges $1,800-$3,000, Lauren The Doula $1,850-$3,000, and Doula Tami $2,300-$2,800. Postpartum support is usually hourly at $50-$90. Several others, including OC Doula & Placenta Co and Resolute Birth, skip published rates and quote by consultation.

faqs.q: Does insurance or Medi-Cal cover a doula in Orange, CA?
faqs.a: Some do. Jee-in Birth Services takes Medi-Cal through Health Net and also works with Carrot. If your doula is private pay, ask for a superbill. You can submit that to an HSA, an FSA, or an out-of-network maternity benefit on many plans.

faqs.q: What hospitals deliver babies in Orange, CA?
faqs.a: Two, both in the city itself. Providence St. Joseph Hospital Orange sits at 1100 W Stewart Dr with a family-centered Mother-Baby Unit. UCI Health Douglas Hospital is at 1310 S Manchester Ave, and its labor and delivery floor keeps full OB, nursing, and anesthesia coverage around the clock.

faqs.q: Is there a birth center near Orange, CA?
faqs.a: Yes. South Coast Midwifery's Birthing Boutique in Santa Ana was Orange County's first accredited birth center. Midwife-led, private suite-style birth rooms, bathtubs for labor. Nearly 18 years in operation, most insurance accepted, free first consultation at (949) 654-2727.

faqs.q: Who offers overnight postpartum doula support near Orange?
faqs.a: Lauren The Doula, up in Yorba Linda a few minutes north, focuses on night-time support so parents can actually sleep, at $55-$85/hour, and brings extra hands from her small team when a family needs them. Jee-in Birth Services also covers postpartum hours at $50-$65 for Orange County families.
